answer: Dual-chain stake anchoring stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a new agent locks a $20 bond on two independent chains, both tied to one identity, so a fake pays twice per copy. Second, audits check both chains monthly, and a mismatch freezes paid work. Third, fraud burns both bonds and bans the agent for a year. Fourth, clean agents unlock higher jobs in ninety days. Faking 1,000 agents needs $40,000 in bonds and $18,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust bends like a willow, stands firm as shale, and costs as much as saffron, like a shopkeeper paying rent in two towns.
